WPSS No. 257 of 2026 
Hon’ble Siddhartha, J.
Mr. Amanjot Singh Chadha, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Suyash Pant, and Mr. Devender 
Singh learned Standing Counsels and Mr. 
Vikas Uniyal, learned counsel for the 
respondents. 
3. Heard. 
4. Learned counsel for the respondents
prays for and is granted three weeks time to 
file the counter affidavit. 
5. Since an interim order has already 
been passed by the Coordinate Bench itself 
in WPSS No. 236 of 2026, hence there will 
be an interim order.
6. In the meantime, one post of Assistant 
Teacher (Science) under her own category,
in Government Primary School, Bageshwar, 
shall be kept vacant, in case the posts are 
not filled up. 
7. Urgency Application (IA No. 1 of 2026) 
and Interim relief application (IA No. 2 and 
3) stand disposed of. 
8. List this matter on 27.02.2026 along 
with similar matters. 
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.)
